rules.title: Draw Stacking
rules.description: MAY-DIFFER (spec 12.4): legacy pending_draws is rebuilt on response windows. This authors the window situation the spec describes (responders @others, respond with the `stackable` tag, duration env) and its two routes. NOT EXPRESSIBLE as phase-1 content: the default route drawing exactly the accumulated vanilla:draw_debt magnitude (draw_cards takes a static `n`) and the response route re-opening the window (graphs are DAGs; re-open is engine-owned). The routes carry only the expressible halves: the response appends the draw_debt status and the default clears it. The amount draw and the window re-open are engine/WP9 responsibilities, so the legacy draw_stacking golden must be compared with may_differ honoured.
